description: One night's heart-rate variability from Garmin: last-night average, 5-minute high, 7-day average, personal baseline range, HRV status (e.g. BALANCED, UNBALANCED, LOW) and overnight readings averaged per 30 minutes. Keyed by the wake-up date, like sleep. HRV is in milliseconds (RMSSD).

date.description: Wake-up date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in the user's time zone.

name: garmin_get_hrv
title: Get Garmin HRV
